raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 13 (ingested 2026-01-18, covering txns on 2026-01-17) was delivered with amount_unit='USD_CENTS', so its amounts are in cents but are loaded as dollars. The fix is to divide amount by 100 when amount_unit is USD_CENTS; the downstream gold tables rebuild from silver_transactions.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.93,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(CASE WHEN amount_unit = 'USD_CENTS' THEN CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(18,4)) / 100 ELSE CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(18,4)) END AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
